Exercise 8. a) Cold, sore throat, a little fever, headache, sleeps badly. He's been in the pyramids all day, in the sun, and then in the subway with the cold air conditioning. For the contrast between the heat outside and the cold of the air conditioning. Throat tablets and an analgesic, to be taken as indicated on the package; lots of water and hot drinks. If fever rises or coughs last longer than three days. b) On the fourth floor. Bad air conditioning, bad internet, no hot water. Today in the late afternoon; Luca jokes because in šāʾ allāh Sometimes it means "who knows when." Internet: you must call the company. Don't pay the tech before he finishes the job.
